**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 22 (¶¶ p0087–p0089) is the only audit right binding us, and it already sits at the playbook's **preferred** position on every material term:

| Term | Playbook preferred | § 22 |
|---|---|---|
| Frequency | Once / 12 months | Once in any twelve-month period ✓ |
| Notice | 30 days' written | At least thirty days' prior written ✓ |
| Timing/manner | Business hours | Normal business hours, no unreasonable disruption ✓ |
| Auditor | Independent, confidentiality-bound | Same, plus off-site where practicable ✓ |
| Cost | Vendor's, unless underpayment > 5% | Vendor bears, shift at >5% ✓ (better than the 10% fallback) |
| System access | None | Express bar on direct system access, unrelated Customer Data, privileged material, third-party confidential info ✓ |

I also confirmed there is no back-door verification right: Section 23 ("Records and Customer Assurance") is a bare heading with no operative text, and a document-wide search for inspection/monitoring/metering/telemetry language turned up nothing binding us. Section 22.3 layers on extra protections in our favour (findings are our Confidential Information, enforcement-only use, copy of the final report, and shortfall payment resolving the audited quantity issue absent fraud or demonstrable error).

Nothing here reaches walk-away territory, so we should leave this clause untouched.
